description: Compare the code with the developer's whiteboard: each drawn component and the real package or component it stands for (by name, then place), the drawn components the code lacks, the forbidden edges the code crosses with the dependencies that cross them, and the required edges it lacks. Check it after changing the structure.
name: get_drift

description: Read the architecture the developer wants, from their whiteboard: layers, intended components (name, layer, role), edges with their policy (allowed, forbidden, required; between layers they hold for all their content), notes and performance budgets, where each shape and freehand stroke is drawn, and an image of the sketch for the freehand drawing. Read it before designing or changing the structure.

image.description: `false`: no image of the sketch, the structure and the places only.

name: get_intended_architecture

description: Read the plan: milestones, their tasks, statuses and progress.
name: get_plan

description: Read a session of the journal: the open one, or the one given.

session_id.description: A session (`S-…`); the open one when absent.

name: get_session

description: Read the todo of the open session.
name: get_todo

description: Add a task to the plan, in an existing milestone or a new one, with its done criterion. Returns the task and its id (T-…).

criterion.description: What says the task is done.

new_milestone.description: The title of a new milestone for the task; or else `milestone`.

name: plan_add_task

description: Change a task of the plan: its status (todo, in_progress, blocked, done, dropped; only allowed transitions), title, criterion, or add a note. Returns the task.

note.description: Why; required to reopen a task that was done.

name: plan_update_task

description: Close the open session at the end of the work, with a summary of what was done and what is left. Returns the session as kept in the journal.

summary.description: What was done, and what is left, in a few sentences.

name: session_end

description: Open a work session before changing the code: give its objective, and the plan's task it serves if any. Writes to the plan and the todo need an open session. Returns the session.

objective.description: What the session is for, in a sentence.

task.description: The task of the plan it works on (`T-…`), if any.

name: session_start

description: Add an item to the todo of the open session, when splitting the work; link it to a task of the plan if any. Returns the item and its id (D-…).
name: todo_add

description: Mark an item of the todo as done, as soon as it is. Returns the item.
name: todo_complete
